label: Gold lines as replies (the booth rolls for a kept line)
description: On a host's reply turn System 3 rolls gold.reply: the 'gold' weight against the 'own words' weight is the chance the seat answers with a line the station kept, word for word. On a hit it rolls which one, weighted by gold.seat and gold.topic. Lines heard in the last 24 hours are never offered. Switch the table off and no gold line is rolled.
